chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who said:

He (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who contracted a slave girl of his. So the slave girl said, 'Whatever I pay off from my contract, so I would be free by it upon the accounting of that.' So he said to her, 'Yes.' So she paid off part of her contract and her master copulated with her after that. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'If he compelled her to that, he would be whipped from the legal penalty (Hadd) by the measurement of what she had paid off from her contract, and it would be staved off from the legal penalty (Hadd) by the measurement of what remains for him from her contract; and if she followed him, so she is an associate of his in the legal penalty (Hadd), and she would be whipped similar to what he would be whipped.'

key_terms.حَدّ: Legal penalty (flogging or imprisonment) prescribed by Sharia
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَة: Contract of manumission where a slave agrees to pay a sum for freedom

ai.seo_question: What is the legal penalty for a master who has sex with his contracted slave girl?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the proportional application of the hadd penalty for sexual intercourse with a contracted slave, distinguishing between forced and consensual acts. This ruling highlights the legal nuance in Shia jurisprudence where the unpaid portion of the mukatabah contract serves as a mitigating factor for the owner, whereas mutual consent results in shared liability. The hadith underscores the economic and legal status of the slave woman as a partial free agent during the contract period.
